item.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
item.description: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.
item.content:encoded:
The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.

item.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

item.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
item.description: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

item.title: Remembering 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart
item.description: Stewart, who died Oct. 28, performed with the Royal Shakespeare Company before becoming famous as Star Trek's Picard. Critic David Bianculli has a tribute, and we listen back to a 2020 interview.

item.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
item.description: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.

item.title: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
item.description: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday. Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.
item.content:encoded:
The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday. Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

(Image credit: Scott Olson)

item.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
item.description: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.
